title: WASM + Go bindings support
description: Implement WebAssembly and Go FFI bindings for Muxide (GitHub issue #1). Branch: feature/wasm-support. Core Rust FFI layer (src/ffi.rs) and WASM bindings (src/wasm.rs) are scaffolded but need finishing. C header, Go package, CI, and PR still needed.
acceptance_criteria: cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm passes. Go example compiles and links. CI green. PR merged.

title: Fix wasm.rs finish() to return output bytes via into_writer()
description: wasm.rs finish() currently returns empty Vec. Must call finish_in_place_with_stats() then into_writer() to retrieve the Vec<u8> output. The into_writer() method was added to Muxer and Mp4Writer but the wasm finish path doesn't use it yet.
acceptance_criteria: WasmMuxer::finish() returns non-empty Vec<u8> containing valid MP4 data

title: Gate [[bin]] section in Cargo.toml behind not(feature=wasm)
description: The CLI binary depends on clap and indicatif which don't compile for wasm32-unknown-unknown. Add required-features = ["wasm"] exclusion or use a [target.'cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))'] section to gate the [[bin]] target.
acceptance_criteria: cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm succeeds without compiling the binary

title: Create bindings/muxide.h C header for FFI layer
description: Write a C header file matching the extern C functions in src/ffi.rs. Include: muxide_new, muxide_new_with_audio, muxide_free, muxide_write_video, muxide_write_video_with_dts, muxide_write_audio, muxide_finish, muxide_output_length, muxide_output_copy, muxide_last_error, and all fragmented variants. Include error code constants and opaque handle typedefs.
acceptance_criteria: Header compiles with gcc -c and all function signatures match the Rust FFI

title: Create bindings/go/ package with Go wrapper and example
description: Create a Go package under bindings/go/ that uses cgo to wrap the C FFI. Include: muxide.go (wrapper with idiomatic Go API), muxide_test.go (basic test), example/main.go (usage example). The Go package should provide: NewMuxer(), WriteVideo(), WriteAudio(), Finish() methods. Use #cgo LDFLAGS to link the shared library.

title: Add WASM build check to CI workflow
description: Add a job to .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm. Should run on ubuntu-latest with stable Rust.
acceptance_criteria: CI workflow includes wasm-check job that passes

title: Verify all checks pass and open PR for WASM branch
description: Run full verification: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test, cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm. Then commit, push feature/wasm-support, and open PR referencing GitHub issue #1. Write a clear PR description explaining the WASM and Go FFI architecture.
acceptance_criteria: PR opened, CI green, PR description complete

title: CI/infra hardening
description: Fix CI warnings, address dependabot vulnerability, and harden the release pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: No CI warnings, no dependabot alerts, release workflow tested

title: Fix Node.js 20 deprecation warnings in GitHub Actions
description: CI annotations show: Node.js 20 is deprecated. actions/checkout@v4 and actions/cache@v4 target Node.js 20. Upgrade to actions/checkout@v5 and actions/cache@v4 (or latest that supports Node 24). Also update softprops/action-gh-release@v1 in release.yml.
acceptance_criteria: No Node.js deprecation warnings in CI run output

title: Address dependabot security vulnerability
description: GitHub reports 1 low-severity vulnerability on the default branch. Check dependabot alerts and apply the fix. Run: gh api repos/Michael-A-Kuykendall/muxide/dependabot/alerts to see details.

title: Verify release.yml workflow builds cross-platform binaries
description: release.yml only builds a Linux binary. It should build for macOS and Windows too. Also the zip command for Linux is wrong (zips the path, not just the binary). Fix the release workflow to produce proper binaries for all 3 platforms.
acceptance_criteria: Release workflow produces muxide-linux.tar.gz, muxide-macos.tar.gz, muxide-windows.zip

title: Support audio-only fragmented MP4 streams
description: GitHub issue #2: Support audio-only fMP4 streams. Currently MissingVideoConfig error is required. Need to make video optional in FragmentedMuxer and MuxerBuilder, allowing audio-only init+media segments.
acceptance_criteria: Can create audio-only fMP4 with init segment + media segments. Plays in browser.

title: Dependency upgrades and code cleanup from v0.2.6 audit
description: Follow-up work from the v0.2.6 production audit. Several dependencies are outdated and minor code quality issues remain.
acceptance_criteria: All deps current, no dead public APIs, no Unicode in validation messages

title: Upgrade thiserror from v1 to v2
description: thiserror v2 is the current major version. v1 still works but v2 has better derive macros. Update Cargo.toml to thiserror = "2.0" and fix any breaking changes in MuxerError, Mp4WriterError, FragmentedError, Vp9Error derives.
acceptance_criteria: cargo check passes with thiserror 2.x. All error types still derive correctly.

title: Replace lazy_static dev-dep with std::sync::LazyLock
description: lazy_static is effectively deprecated. MSRV is now 1.81 which has std::sync::LazyLock stabilized. Remove lazy_static from dev-dependencies and replace any usage in tests with LazyLock.
acceptance_criteria: lazy_static removed from Cargo.toml. Tests still pass.

title: Upgrade criterion from 0.5 to 0.8
description: criterion 0.5 is unmaintained. Upgrade to 0.8. Check benches/muxing.rs for API changes.
acceptance_criteria: cargo bench compiles and runs with criterion 0.8

title: Unpin proptest from =1.5.0 to allow updates
description: proptest is pinned to exactly 1.5.0. Current is 1.11. Change to proptest = "1" in dev-dependencies and verify property tests still pass.
acceptance_criteria: proptest unpinned, cargo test --test property_tests passes

title: Gate is_valid_vp9_frame() as test-only or remove dead public API
description: is_valid_vp9_frame() in vp9.rs:255 is public but never called from production code. Either mark it #[cfg(test)] or remove it entirely. It's a trivial 3-line function that duplicates what is_vp9_keyframe already does.
acceptance_criteria: Function is either test-only or removed. No dead public APIs remain.

title: Replace Unicode checkmarks in validation.rs with ASCII
description: validation.rs uses Unicode checkmarks (✓, ⚠) in messages. These may not render correctly in all terminals. Replace with ASCII equivalents like [OK], [WARN], [ERR].
acceptance_criteria: No Unicode symbols in validation messages. Messages still readable.
